name: allowListAdded
description: This event is fired when a player was added to the allow list

name: allowListRemoved
description: This event is fired when a player was removed from the allow list

name: banAdded
description: This event is fired when a player was banned

name: banRemoved
description: This event is fired when a player was unbanned

name: error
description: This event is fired when an error occurred

name: gameRuleUpdated
description: This event is fired when a game rule was updated

name: ipBanAdded
description: This event is fired when an IP was banned

name: ipBanRemoved
description: This event is fired when an IP was unbanned

name: operatorAdded
description: This event is fired when an operator was added

name: operatorRemoved
description: This event is fired when an operator was removed

name: playerJoined
description: This event is fired when a player has joined the server

name: playerLeft
description: This event is fired when a player has left the server

name: serverActivity
description: This event is fired when a network connection to the server has been initiated

name: serverSaved
description: This event is fired when the server was saved

name: serverSaving
description: This event is fired when the server is saving

name: serverStarted
description: This event is fired when the server has started

name: serverStatus
description: This event is fired when the server status was received

name: serverStopping
description: This event is fired when the server is stopping
